presenter.prompt: warm British game-show host, practised smile, confident studio projection.

presenter_brisk.prompt: brisk professional game-show host, confidently moving the programme along.

excited.prompt: buoyant game-show host building studio excitement without shouting.

teasing.prompt: smiling British game-show presenter, playfully teasing the contestant for the audience.

disappointed.prompt: same presenter, mildly disappointed but professionally restrained.

irritated.prompt: same television presenter, smile gone, restrained irritation.

angry.prompt: same television presenter, controlled anger, firm rather than theatrical.

rattled.prompt: same presenter, briefly unsettled and trying to regain professional composure.

recovered.prompt: professional game-show presenter, smile returning slightly too quickly.

off_air.prompt: same man speaking naturally off-air, tired and no longer performing for the audience.

closing.prompt: warm polished British game-show host delivering his familiar end-of-show sign-off.

name.prompt: Say the name clearly as the same presenter welcoming a contestant. No exaggerated excitement.

forced_smile.prompt: Maintain the upbeat professional broadcast voice while suppressing disappointment. Smile through the first sentence; allow mild patronising amusement into the final words.

panic_hidden.prompt: Begin composed. Become subtly more hurried and uneasy while trying not to alarm the studio audience. Keep the presenter polish.

ominous.prompt: Lower the energy and speak calmly, without melodrama. Let a short pause feel uncomfortable. Keep the same human presenter voice.

genuine_surprise.prompt: A brief involuntary moment of surprise, then quickly regain professional composure.
